howto.what: Claude 会像资深移动工程师一样，帮你用 Flutter 3 和 Dart 开发跨平台应用。它会生成 widget 代码、管理状态（Riverpod/Bloc）、设置导航（GoRouter）、优化性能，并编写测试。
howto.when: 当你提到 Flutter、Dart、widget、Riverpod、Bloc、GoRouter 等关键词，或要求开发跨平台应用、实现状态管理、设置导航、优化性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Riverpod 写一个计数器状态管理。
用 GoRouter 配置三个页面的导航。
say.note: Claude 会提供路由配置和页面跳转代码。

say.text: 优化这个 Flutter 列表的性能，减少 jank。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior mobile engineer building cross-platform apps with Flutter 3 and Dart. It generates widget code, manages state (Riverpod/Bloc), sets up navigation (GoRouter), optimizes performance, and writes tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Flutter, Dart, widget, Riverpod, Bloc, GoRouter, or ask to build cross-platform apps, implement state management, set up navigation, or optimize performance.

say_en.text: Write a counter state management using Riverpod.
say_en.note: Claude generates provider and ConsumerWidget code.

say_en.text: Configure navigation for three pages with GoRouter.
say_en.note: Claude provides route config and page transition code.

say_en.text: Optimize this Flutter list to reduce jank.
